card.name: Coadministration in drug interaction tables
card.fires_on: The ending of 'Coadministration' (or 'Concomitant administration') in drug interaction tables, and the space after a comma in numbered section cross-references like '( 5.7 , 7.1 ,'.

modes.label: Coadministration ending
modes.description: The 'istration' piece of 'Coadministration' right after a drug class list and arrow, before 'is contraindicated'.
